bind_address.description: Network interface and port to bind Daphne to (e.g., `0.0.0.0:8000` or `:8000`).

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests.

connection_timeout.description: Number of seconds to wait before closing idle connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections Daphne will accept.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: one of debug, info, warning, error, critical.

application.description: Django ASGI application module path in dotted notation.

http_max_header_size.description: Maximum allowed size for HTTP request headers in bytes. If omitted, uses Twisted default (~8192 bytes).

websocket_ping_interval.description: Seconds between WebSocket ping messages to detect dead connections. Requires Daphne ≥ 3.0.

websocket_ping_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for ping response before closing WebSocket. Requires Daphne ≥ 3.0.

keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file.

ca_certs.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for client verification (optional).

access_log.description: Path to file where access logs should be written (stdout if omitted).

error_log.description: Path to file where error logs should be written (stderr if omitted).

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to Daphne (e.g., `--proxy-headers` or `--root-path /api`).

server_name.description: Custom value for the `Server:` HTTP response header. Use for masking server identity.

allowed_hosts.description: List of host/domain names this server is allowed to serve. Required for Django ≥ 3.0 if `DEBUG=False`.
